payload.name: AddNewMemoryForDistinctCategoryItem
payload.description: When deciding to UPDATE or ADD during construction, and the user's new message introduces a different item (book, show, activity, etc.) than one already stored in memory.
content: When a new mention refers to a different item in the same category as an existing memory (e.g., a different book title when the memory stores an earlier book), do not UPDATE that memory as a correction. Preserve the earlier memory and ADD a new memory for the new item; if the old item is no longer current, set its world_end instead of deleting its content.

Apply UPDATE only when the new information is about the same item as the existing memory: correct a factual error or enrich with compatible details. If the new item is distinct, a separate memory is required so later questions about the full history remain answerable.

solves: The failure occurred because a later mention of a different book was applied as a correction, overwriting an earlier reading memory. The reusable mechanism is treating 'new distinct item in the same category' as a correction of the old item. The rule applies whenever a user mentions a new book, show, activity, or similar category item after an earlier different one was stored: preserve the prior memory and ADD the new one; use UPDATE only for genuine same-item corrections or enrichments.
